column1: # Curated subset of HGNC symbol changes relevant to hypoxia / DNA-repair /
# proliferation signatures used in this project.
# PROVENANCE: this is a hand-curated subset, NOT the full HGNC download.
# It is committed so tests and CI are deterministic and offline. To build the
# complete table for a run, use tools/fetch_hgnc.py, which downloads the
# official HGNC complete set, writes the same TSV layout, and prints the
# checksum to pin in specs and manifests.
